tools.name: explain_seller_metric
tools.description: Explains a metric SellerFile reports for Walmart Marketplace sellers (Sales, Net revenue, Gross profit, ACOS, ROAS and others): what it means and how it is calculated. No sign-in needed.

tools.name: get_profit_summary
tools.description: Headline metrics (Sales, units, orders, ad spend, gross profit and more) and the P&L section totals of the signed-in seller's Walmart stores for a period (default yesterday, in the seller's timezone), optionally compared with the previous period or last year. Read-only.

tools.name: get_product_profit
tools.description: Per-SKU sales, units, ad spend and profit of the signed-in seller's Walmart stores for a period, sorted by sales, units, profit or ad spend, 10 rows by default and at most 25. Read-only.

tools.name: get_report_result
tools.description: Returns the result of a get_profit_summary or get_product_profit call that answered with status running, by its report_id. Results are kept about 15 minutes and returned once.
